EC2: - Volar displaced (Smith's) type fractures (well established as being unstable [AND] and requiring surgical treatment)
EC3: - Unable or unwilling to give informed consent
EC4: - [NOT] Unable or unwilling to be followed up (e.g. orthopaedic follow up in another region)
EC5: - Major trauma [AND] with other injuries [AND] and ISS (Injury Severity Score) >16
EC6: - Urgent manipulation required due to neurovascular [OR] or skin compromise
EC7: - Open fractures [OR] or those with associated nerve [OR] or tendon involvement (affect functional outcome)
